newsitem.title: USA: Santander pays $146mln for Bancoquia stake.
newsitem.headline: Santander pays $146mln for Bancoquia stake.

text.p: Banco Santander SA and Grupo Bavaria said Wednesday that Santander has reached a definitive agreement to buy 55 percent of privately held Bancoquia for $146 million. The execution of the transaction, said the companies, will take place no later than July 30.

As a result of the agreement, the companies said Bancoquia will restructure certain parts of its business, including selling its investment bank and buying privately held Invercredito, Colombia's largest consumer lending company, for $86 million.

Bancoquia is the sixth-largest private commercial bank in Colombia, with $1.547 billion in assets. Invercredito is the country's largest consumer lending company. Privately held Grupo Bavaria is one of Colombia's largest conglomerates. Grupo Santander is the largest Spanish banking group, with $148 billion in assets.
